overview.description: The Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF (ASMU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the ASML Holding NV Sponsored ADR index. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of ASML Holding N.V.  (NASDAQ: ASML). ASMU was launched on Feb 11, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
